items.source: This accessor does not resolve static methods and also no technical methods on java.lang.Object or java.lang.Class. For unrestricted resolution, choose ReflectiveMethodResolver instead.
items.translation: 此访问器不解析静态方法，也不解析 `java.lang.Object` 或 `java.lang.Class` 上的技术方法。如需无限制解析，请选择 ReflectiveMethodResolver。

items.source: The default implementation considers any method as a candidate, even for static methods and non-user-declared methods on the Object base class.
items.translation: 默认实现会将任何方法都视为候选项，即使这些方法是静态方法或 `Object` 基类上的非用户声明方法。

items.source: There are three kinds of matches that might occur:
items.translation: 可能会出现三种类型的匹配：

items.source: Create a new data-binding method resolver for instance method resolution.
items.translation: 为实例方法解析创建一个新的数据绑定方法解析器。

items.translation: `resolve` 类中的 `ReflectiveMethodResolver`

items.source: method - the Method to evaluate
items.translation: method - 要评估的 Method

items.source: targetClass - the concrete target class that is being introspected
items.translation: targetClass - 正在被内省的具象目标类

items.source:
An exact match where the types of the arguments match the types of the
method.
items.translation: 参数类型与方法类型完全匹配的确切匹配。

items.source:
An inexact match where the types we are looking for are subtypes of
those defined on the method.
items.translation: 我们寻找的类型是方法定义中类型的子类型时的不精确匹配。

items.source:
A match where we are able to convert the arguments into those expected
by the method, according to the registered type converter.
items.translation: 能够根据已注册的类型转换器将参数转换为方法所期望类型的匹配项。

items.source: Determine whether the given Method is a candidate for method resolution on an instance of the given target class.
items.translation: 确定给定的Method是否为给定目标类实例的方法解析候选项。

items.source: Locate a method on the type.
items.translation: 在类型上定位一个方法。

items.source: a MethodExecutor that can invoke the method, or null if the method cannot be found
items.translation: 一个可以调用该方法的 `MethodExecutor`，或者如果找不到该方法则为 `null`。

items.source: context - the current evaluation context
items.translation: context - 当前评估上下文

items.source: targetObject - the object upon which the method is being called
items.translation: targetObject - 该方法调用的对象

items.source: name - the name of the method
items.translation: name - 方法名称

items.source: argumentTypes - the types of arguments that the method must be able to handle
items.translation: argumentTypes - 该方法必须能够处理的参数类型
